title: NodeGX — what's new
description: Release notes shown in the NodeGX editor. An empty items list means there is nothing to announce; the editor treats that as a normal state and opens no modal.

items.title: NodeGX 0.3.0
items.content_html:
NodeGX 0.3.0

Projects made in 0.2 are upgraded when you open them. The first time you open one, NodeGX copies the whole project folder to <project>.before-0.3, turns its text styles into typography tokens, and tells you it did. Keep that copy until you are happy with the upgraded project.

A new Styles panel. Colours, tokens and Looks are in one place, with visual editors for shadows, gradients, animation timing and fonts.

Properties have their own column on the right, and there is a Layers tab beside Components.

Your backend has its own page in the browser. Open it from the Backend card. The backend panels have moved there from the editor.

Everything in 0.3.0
